observed_in: Stealth and Awareness System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls the distance at which creatures can detect the player based on their awareness, which can vary from very short ranges to extensive distances. Different games implement this with varying degrees of sensitivity to player actions, environmental factors, and the creature's own attributes.
exclusion_criteria: Detection range is fixed and does not change with gameplay
All creatures have the same detection capabilities regardless of context
inclusion_criteria: Detection range is influenced by creature type or behavior
Environmental factors like light and sound affect detection range
title: Detection Range Variability
